description: This file defines an AuthProvider class for managing authentication state in a Flutter application. It supports mock login/logout functionality, persists state with SharedPreferences, and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based class managing authentication state with mock support, persistent storage, and listener notification.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores authentication state from persistent storage.

methods.name: loginMock
methods.description: Simulates a login by updating state and persisting credentials.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by resetting state and removing credentials from persistent storage.
